data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate shows no material opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 (opening claims outstanding shown as nil) and a small gross claims outstanding balance at 31 December 2015 relating to the 2015 underwriting year. No explicit prior-year reserve movement (gross) is disclosed in the notes or narrative, and the claims development table shows only a 2015 column with gross cumulative claims. Therefore prior year development is effectively nil/flat.
raw_causal_phrases: The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience. This includes assumptions in respect of average claim costs, claim handling costs, claim inflation factors and claim numbers for each underwriting year.

The uncertainty associated with the ultimate claims experience of an underwriting year is greatest when the underwriting year is at an early stage of development and the margin for future experience potentially being more adverse than assumed is at its highest.
data.data_quality_notes: Financial statements are presented in US dollars. Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2015 is shown as nil in the Statement of Financial Position (page 12). No explicit gross prior-year movement (movement in prior underwriting years) is provided in the notes or narrative; the technical provisions and claims development table show only a 2015 gross claims amount. Segmental premium breakdown (regulatory/divisional) was not present in the pages provided, so gross_premium_mix is not available. Prior year development set to 0.0 due to absence of any older underwriting year reserves.
